title: Product Explode View with GLB Parts
prompt:
Create a single HTML file that implements a 3D product exploded view with interactive part inspection using Three.js.

## Three.js Import (MUST follow exactly)
In the <head>, use this importmap and import via ES Module in <script type="module">:
```html
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
import { CSS2DRenderer, CSS2DObject } from 'three/addons/renderers/CSS2DRenderer.js';
</script>
```

## Scene Setup
- Background color: 0xf0f0f0 (light gray, clean product display).
- PerspectiveCamera at position (3, 2, 5), looking at (0, 0, 0).
- OrbitControls enabled for mouse rotation/zoom.
- DirectionalLight at (5, 8, 5) with intensity 1.2, and a second DirectionalLight at (-3, 5, -5) with intensity 0.6 for fill. AmbientLight with intensity 0.5.
- A subtle ground plane at y=-1, large circle (radius 3), color 0xdddddd with slight opacity, receiving shadows.
- CSS2DRenderer overlaid on the WebGL canvas for part labels.

## Product Model (AntiqueCamera.glb)
- Load AntiqueCamera.glb using GLTFLoader from path './AntiqueCamera.glb'.
- Once loaded, traverse the scene graph and collect all Mesh children. Store them in an array called 'parts'.
- Center the entire model at the origin. Compute the bounding box of the assembled model and normalize scale so the longest dimension is ~2 units.
- For each part (mesh), compute its 'explode direction': a unit vector from the model center to the part's center position. Store each part's original local position.

## Explode Animation
- Slider id='slider-explode' controls the explode distance factor (range 0-3, step 0.01, default 0, label 'Explode Distance').
- When explode distance is 0, all parts are in their original assembled positions.
- When explode distance is d, each part is displaced by: newPos = originalPos + explodeDirection * d * partDistanceFromCenter. Parts farther from center move more.
- The transition should be smooth: if the slider is being dragged, parts animate to their target positions each frame using lerp (factor 0.15).
- Each part should slightly rotate outward as it explodes (rotate around its explode direction axis by d * 0.1 radians).

## Part Highlighting
- Implement raycasting on mouse move. When the mouse hovers over a part, that part should:
  - Glow with an emissive color (emissive: 0x4444ff, emissiveIntensity: 0.3).
  - Display a CSS2D label above the part showing 'Part N' (where N is the part index, 0-based) and the mesh name if available.
- When mouse leaves a part, remove the highlight and hide the label.
- Clicking on a highlighted part toggles its 'selected' state. Selected parts get a persistent outline effect (set emissive to 0xff8800, emissiveIntensity: 0.4) and their label stays visible.

## Part Labels (CSS2D)
- Use CSS2DRenderer to create floating labels.
- Each label is a div with class 'part-label', styled: background rgba(0,0,0,0.8), color white, padding 4px 8px, border-radius 4px, font-size 12px, pointer-events none.
- Labels are hidden by default and shown on hover or when a part is selected.

## Controls
- Slider id='slider-explode': range 0-3, step 0.01, default 0. Controls explosion distance.
- Slider id='slider-opacity': range 0.1-1, step 0.05, default 1. Controls the opacity of non-selected parts (selected parts always at full opacity). Label 'Part Opacity'.
- Button id='btn-reset': Reset explode to 0, deselect all parts, opacity to 1.
- Button id='btn-explode-full': Animate explode slider from current to 2.0 over 1 second.
- Button id='btn-assemble': Animate explode slider from current to 0 over 1 second.
- Keyboard: 'p' toggles pause, 'r' resets view.

## HUD (id='hud')
- Position: top-left, semi-transparent dark background, padding 12px, monospace 14px, white text.
- Sub-elements:
  - id='hud-parts': total number of parts detected.
  - id='hud-explode': current explode distance value.
  - id='hud-selected': number of currently selected parts.
  - id='hud-hovered': name/index of currently hovered part or 'none'.
  - id='hud-opacity': current opacity value.

## State Management
Every frame, update window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- frameCount (int): incremented each frame.
- partCount (int): total number of parts detected from the GLB.
- explodeDistance (float): current explode distance value from slider.
- selectedCount (int): number of currently selected parts.
- hoveredPart (int or -1): index of hovered part, -1 if none.
- opacity (float): current opacity value.
- partsPositions (array): each element { x, y, z } of current part world positions.
- explodeValid (boolean): true if all part positions are finite and partCount > 0.
- isPaused (boolean): pause state.
- isAnimating (boolean): true if auto-explode or auto-assemble animation is in progress.
physics_constraints: Explode displacement: each part moves along its direction from model center, proportional to its distance from center times the explode factor. Parts must return exactly to original positions when explode=0. Opacity changes must not affect selected parts.
